reason: I already pay for AngelSense and it has never failed me on GPS or the SOS button. A video camera sounds nice, but I need to know it will actually connect when Mom is confused and wandering two hours away, and I can't find out from a flyer. I'm not paying $249 plus another $20 a month on a promise.
objection: Will the video actually connect in a real emergency, or will it freeze or drop when I need it most and the cell signal is bad?
would_change_my_mind: A free or refundable trial where I can test a live video call with Mom from two hours away, with a clear answer on what happens when the signal is weak.
